```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(imputeTS)
data <- read_csv("wellington.csv") %>%
  mutate(Date = yearmonth(paste(Year, Month))) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = Date)

training <- data %>%
  filter(Date <= yearmonth("2025 April"))

test <- data %>%
  filter(Date > yearmonth("2025 April"))

colSums(is.na(data))

scan_gaps(data)

data <- data %>%
  fill_gaps() %>%
  mutate(YourColumn = na_seadec(Temperature, algorithm = "interpolation"))
```
